LanguageData.RatkinTunnel_Guerrilla.label: tunnel invasion
LanguageData.RatkinTunnel_Guerrilla.letterText: The ground quakes as the sounds of something rapidly drills towards the surface! Ratkin guerrillas are about to make way into your base!
LanguageData.RatkinFollowUpTroops.label: follow up raid
LanguageData.RatkinFollowUpTroops.letterText: After power is lost, hostile forces waiting outside the area enter to support the assault! Mount a defense!
LanguageData.RK_Incident_VagabondJoin.label: wanderers join
LanguageData.RK_Incident_VagabondJoin.letterText: In a moment of crisis, a couple of wandering ratkin appear and join the colony without question. Can they change your fate?
LanguageData.RK_Incident_PriestJoin.label: priest joins
LanguageData.RK_Incident_PriestJoin.letterText:
Priest [PAWN_nameDef] offers to join your settlement.
[PAWN_pronoun] is deeply faithful and has a healing touch.
LanguageData.RK_Incident_WanderingTrader.label: Wandering trader arrives
